name: A Fork in The Road
description:
With the creation of the Black Hole Compressor, three different paths have opened up.

The Top Path: The Bose-Einstein Multiblocks
A suite of multiblocks for late game assembly.

[note]This path makes the other two paths faster and cheaper.[/note]

The Middle Path: Antimatter
A fancy new power generation method to keep up with rising EU costs.

[note]This path makes the other two paths easier to scale by giving you more power to burn.[/note]

The Bottom Path: The Forge of the Gods
The largest multiblock, capable of smelting everything you could ever want.

[note]This path makes the other two paths faster by speeding up ingot smelting.[/note]
